rubric.evidence: Every grammar rule, overload signature, precondition, and error behavior was extracted from the live merged WGSL spec text (gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/wgsl §6.3, §17.14, §4.1.2, conversion-rank table, §13.3.4) and the merged proposal on 2026-07-29; overloads quoted verbatim; PR #6291 merge state (2026-07-14), dawn.json extension value 9, and the CTS test files were fetched live, not assumed.

Slug webgpu-buffer-view-feature derived by executing the repo's own slugify() on the exact listing name 'WebGPU: `buffer_view` feature' (underscore collapses per [^a-z0-9]+ rule — the task's expected underscore-preserving slug was verified wrong against code); milestone v153 from the feature's position in the milestone=153 listing (Enabled by default); identity 5094091886034944 on all 4 routes.

Inventory covers the full developer-facing surface: buffer types, extension mechanics, JS-side detection, all three built-ins (child routes), and the buffer-pointer automatic conversions; nine dimensions each with sourced not-applicable rationales where genuinely empty (directive inputs, detection errors).

Model-first structure (why → types → mechanics → built-ins → conversions) with the interprocedural minimum-size subtlety given its own explanation and the spec's worked example; the proposal's many open TODOs (minimum binding size, struct-depth limits) are noted where they affect the contract but not enumerated exhaustively.

Five semantic pre/code examples: proposal-derived wireframe packing (WGSL + JS), detection snippet, requires-directive snippet, conversion example, and the spec's own bufferLength example (with an honest note that the spec example's duplicate @binding(0) is shown corrected to @binding(1) here). Runtime execution not possible locally (no WebGPU GPU in the headless environment).

No BCD key exists for the feature (verified in api/GPU.json) and webstatus has no entry (zero-match query linked) — interim tables are labelled as such and compiled from the listing/record plus the exact standards-positions links on the record; the detection API's real BCD support table (Chrome 144/115-partial, Android 121, Firefox 141 partial, Safari 26) is shown separately.

All citation labels are direct links (zero plain-text sources); WGSL anchors verified present in the live spec HTML (#buffer-types, #buffer-view-builtin-functions, #language-extensions-sec, #conversion-rank, #buffer-binding-determines-runtime-sized-array-element-count, #arrayLength-builtin). Full curl sweep of all external hrefs still pending at report time.

openQuestions: The proposal leaves the API-side minimum-binding-size rule for buffer-typed bindings as a TODO ('Decide on minimum binding size'); the merged WGSL text defines the shader-side minimum-size analysis but the WebGPU spec has no buffer_view content — the exact minBindingSize contract a developer should assume is therefore undocumented in normative text.

The proposal's TODO on restricting T to a single level of structures is unresolved in the proposal text; the merged spec's precondition ('T must satisfy the address space layout constraints') is what the page documents — whether implementations accept nested structs beyond current WGSL uniform-layout rules is untested here.

Dawn tags the extension ['dawn'] in dawn.json while the WGSL spec now standardizes it; whether/when the jsrepr 'buffer_view' string seen by wgslLanguageFeatures changes is not recorded in any source read.

The spec example for bufferLength declares two variables at the same @binding(0); whether that is a spec-example bug (assumed here, with a correction note) or intended has not been confirmed with the editors.
